Peanut Pastry
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 1:51am

Ingredients




1 cup Flour
teaspoon Baking powder
Salt, pinch
cup Shortening
4 tablespoons Peanut butter, smooth
Cold water

Preparation

1 Sift the flour, baking powder, and salt together. Cut in the shortening and the peanut butter with a pastry blender. Add just enough water to make it stick together. Chill. Roll out the pastry, fit it into the pan, prick all over with a fork and bake in a 475 def oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool before filling. 2 NOTES :* Big Chocolate Cookbook......Gertrude Parke
